areas.title: Notification type and origin of the import
areas.scope: Starting a notification (create-notification, the notification type question in the prototype and the INS front door, where each choice sends the trader, the reference given to a new notification) and the origin of the import page: country of origin, the region of origin code question and prefix, the internal reference, their saving, validation and exits. Stops at what-are-you-importing (commodities). The countries list content and the reference-data and MDM stub mechanics behind it are reference-lists. Includes the high-risk plants frontend origin page and its origin rulings (plants starts on the commodity type, so plants has no notification type question).

areas.title: What are you importing: commodity search and selection
areas.scope: Commodity and species selection for live animals and germinal products: the commodity search, its results and the selection panel, the commodity and species lists, removing a chosen commodity or species, and the commodity reference service behind them. Stops at the commodity details page (commodity-details), animal identification and the reason for import. Includes the high-risk plants frontend commodity type page and commodity vocabulary and its commodity rulings, where a row changes the same page plants also has.

areas.title: Commodity details: species quantities and commodity lines
areas.scope: The commodity details (consignment details) page for live animals and germinal products: the block per chosen commodity and species, number of animals, number of packages, net weight, storage temperature and quantity, removing a commodity or species, its validation and limits, and the commodity line collection in the plants frontend (its list page and details sub-page). It stops at choosing commodities (commodities), the germinal total gross weight page (germinal-products) and additional details (reason-and-additional-details).

areas.title: Main reason for import and additional details
areas.scope: The main reason for import page with every reason, its hints and conditional reveals (internal market purpose, transhipment destination, transit exit point and destination, temporary admission exit date and point, re-entry), and the additional (animal) details page: certification purpose, unweaned animals and when the page applies. Stops at commodity details and identification.

areas.title: Animal identification details
areas.scope: The identification details page: which species need identifying and with which identifiers (ear tag, passport, microchip, tattoo, germinal donor and dates), entering, saving and removing animals, the per-line count and its cap, identifier validation, the selected-commodities summary on the page, and the per-animal permanent address fields the real frontend keeps on this page today. Stops at the permanent address page in consignment parties.

areas.title: Germinal products set: its data fields and germinal-only page behaviour
areas.scope: The germinal products (semen, embryos and ova) sibling set of live animals: the Germinal Data Elements of the Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields V4 page (at least one germinal identifier per animal, total gross weight, quantity, temperature, donor name/ID, collection date, production date, identification number/mark, their levels, limits, mandatory status and the 12 'Applicable to' commodity codes; CPH and permanent address not required; the de-scoped approved establishment and package type), and the germinal-only behaviour of the journey pages in Design Release 2.1: starting from the germinal category, the 15 germinal commodities and their search, the germinal commodity details block (weight, packages, temperature and their errors), the germinal-only reasons and internal market purposes, no additional details page, and germinal identification (one entry per species, the four fields, date pickers, their errors, counting as identified). Stops at the shared, live-animal behaviour of each page (that page's own area), the germinal list, cards and home section (notification-list, dashboard-home), the hub cards and rows (notification-hub), the review rows (review-and-submit) and the Standard Address Block (address-book-add-and-edit).

areas.title: Arrival details, port of entry and transit countries
areas.scope: The arrival details page (arrival date and its window, port of entry, means of transport, transport identification and document reference) and the transit countries page (when it applies, adding and removing countries, the cap). Stops at the transporter pages. The ports-of-entry list content and the service behind it are reference-lists. Includes the high-risk plants frontend arrival status and arrival details pages, its timing windows and arrival rulings.

areas.title: Transporter selection and adding a transporter
areas.scope: Choosing a transporter during a notification: the transporter page (list, search, type, status, view details, choosing and removing one) and adding a transporter from the journey (choosing commercial or private, the commercial and private transporter forms, their validation, and the new transporter becoming selectable). Stops at arrival details and at transporter records managed in the INS address book (transporter-records).

areas.title: Transporter records in the address book
areas.scope: Transporters as per-organisation records managed in the INS address book: the address book service transporters collection and its five operations (fields, the private or commercial type, approval number, commercial country), the INS frontend transporter type question, private and commercial add pages, and the transporter view, edit and delete pages, with the tests repo transporter specs. It stops at choosing a transporter during a notification, which the transporters area claims.

areas.title: Upload documents
areas.scope: The upload documents page and the accompanying-document record: document types, reference and date of issue, attachments and their limits, the virus scan and its states, listing, viewing, downloading and removing documents, the uploader handshake and file storage. Stops at how documents show on the review page.

areas.title: Roles and addresses page and the party pickers
areas.scope: The consignment addresses (roles and addresses) page and the five party pickers: which roles show for which commodity, role hints, the add links, the same-as shortcuts, the picker search, list, pagination, view details and selection, which addresses a picker offers, saving a pick, and the animals frontend's read of the address book. Stops at adding a new address from the journey and editing a copied address (party-address-add-and-edit), and at the CPH number, permanent address and contact address (cph-permanent-and-contact). Includes the high-risk plants frontend's place of destination and consignor pickers, its shared address-book picker helpers, its identification numbers page and party reference handling.

areas.title: Adding and editing a party address from the journey
areas.scope: Getting a new address into a party from inside the journey (the prototype's in-journey add-address pages with manual entry, UK lookup and other uses; today's add handshake to the INS address book and the return), and the copied address a notification holds: copy semantics, editing the copy, its validation, rule-breaking copies blocking submit, and the copy frozen after submission. Stops at the address book's own add page (address-book-add-and-edit).

areas.title: CPH number, permanent address and contact address
areas.scope: The CPH number page and when it applies; the permanent address page for pets (per-animal choice, same as place of destination, new address fields) and when it applies; and the contact address for the consignment page (which addresses it offers, current contact, adding a branch address, saving and editing the contact copy). Stops at the five party pickers. Includes the high-risk plants frontend's consignment contact page and its contact rulings.

areas.title: Notification hub (overview task list)
areas.scope: The notification hub: its heading, status strip, commodity total cards, the numbered task list sections and rows, which rows show for which commodity, row statuses and what makes each complete, the Review and submit and Return to dashboard buttons. Stops at the pages the rows open and at the review page. Includes the high-risk plants frontend's hub (Overview) page, its task rows and their statuses.

areas.title: Review page (check your answers)
areas.scope: The review (check your answers) page in every variant: journey, draft, submitted read-only and action-required views, its sections, cards, rows, change links, incomplete-card errors and header (status, dates, import reference numbers); and what counts as complete enough to submit. Stops at the declaration and submitted pages (declaration-and-submitted) and at the amend, cancel-amend, copy and delete actions the header offers (manage-notifications). Includes the high-risk plants frontend check answers page and its review helpers and lateness rules.

areas.title: Declaration and notification submitted pages
areas.scope: The declaration page (its statements, checkbox, date and submit) and the page shown after submitting (reference panel, what the trader still owes, help links, inspection and transporter guidance), in the prototype, the animals frontend, the plants frontend and the tests repo declaration and confirmation specs. It stops at the review page (review-and-submit) and at delete and cancel amendment (manage-notifications).

areas.title: Overall dashboard home and at-a-glance drill-downs
areas.scope: The service's home: the DR2.1 overall dashboard (category sections, glance cards and counts, Create new and Use template, messages), the prototype index, the at-a-glance drill-downs (action needed, status updated, inspection required) and today's INS front-door dashboard at / with its aggregated read model handoff and cross-service dashboards. Stops at a category's notification list (notification-list).

areas.title: Notification lists: cards, tabs, search, sort and filters
areas.scope: A category's notifications list (DR2.1 live animals and germinal products lists; today's animals dashboard): summary cards, tabs, notification cards and the facts and statuses they show, the actions a card offers, search, sort, additional filters, pagination, results count, empty and success states, and the list APIs and read model behind them (animals backend list, INS backend read model). Stops at what each card action does (manage-notifications). Includes the high-risk plants frontend's dashboard (its notification list), its cards, sort, search, pagination, row actions, late tag and its dashboard rulings, since plants' list is reframed in the same increments.

areas.title: Address book list, view and delete
areas.scope: The address book list (heading, intro, category tabs, search and type filter, table columns, pagination, results count, success banners), viewing one address, deleting an address (confirmation, soft delete, tombstones), organisation scoping and caller identity, and the list, read and delete APIs. Stops at adding and editing an address (address-book-add-and-edit).

areas.title: Address book: add and edit an address
areas.scope: Adding an address to the address book (choosing a type or category, manual entry, the fields, roles and their hints, validation, saving, the return to a journey section or contact address, and the add handshake on the INS side) and editing an address (prefill, fields, validation, save and cancel); the address record, its fields and validation, and the create, read-one, update and delete APIs and their error shapes. Stops at the list, view and delete pages (address-book-list) and at finding an address by postcode (address-lookup).

areas.title: Address lookup by postcode
areas.scope: Finding an address by postcode: the prototype postcode find-address pages mounted for the address book add journey and each consignment address section, the INS frontend address lookup spike (dev and local only) with its search-mode detection, client and stub, and the stub address lookup simulator the INS backend calls (reserved search terms, addresses, postcodes and errors). Address search waits until the INS address lookup is a real feature; until then add-address pages offer manual entry only. It stops at the address form itself (address-book-add-and-edit, party-address-add-and-edit).

areas.title: Templates
areas.scope: Notification templates: the manage templates list, creating a template (type, name, answers in template mode, review, save, untitled, discard), viewing a saved template, changing a section, editing, using a template to start a notification, and deleting a template. No real service has templates today. The high-risk plants frontend has no templates today; its ledger's parked reuse-previous-consignment ruling (d-038) is here.

areas.title: Amend, cancel amendment, copy as new and delete
areas.scope: The actions on an existing notification: amend (the modal, the amend state, resubmitting), cancel amendment (modal or page, restoring the submitted answers), copy as new (what carries over and what is cleared, the new reference) and delete (confirmation page, soft delete, the success message), with the backend endpoints, state transitions and concurrency rules behind them, and saved drafts. Stops at the review page itself and at the notification list. Includes the high-risk plants frontend's delete notification and cancel amendment pages, its dashboard Amend action's effect and its post-submission action rulings.

areas.title: Notification record, persistence and publishing
areas.scope: The stored notification behind every page: its fields and validation, status values and reference format, create, save and submit, fulfilment and reference-number reads, hard delete, expiry and the admin guard, what is persisted, the outbox events and GBN-AG payload published on submit, and what reaches PIMS Dynamics. Stops at amend, cancel-amend, copy and soft delete (manage-notifications) and at the list API (notification-list). Includes the high-risk plants ledger's rulings on the reference, status lifecycle and data retention.

areas.title: Country and port reference lists
areas.scope: The countries and ports-of-entry reference lists as today serves them: the reference-data service endpoints for countries and ports (fields, filters, order, subdivisions, port types, caching, MDM calls and errors), its contract, ADRs and missing lists, and the MDM stub that answers it locally (the subscription key, the blocks filter, every country record and every port record it returns). It claims what the lists hold and how they are served, not how a page shows them: the origin, transit and arrival areas claim that. Under the goal, list content belongs to MDM and is never edited in code to match the prototype.

areas.title: The animals frontend's recorded decisions and page-design record
areas.scope: Everything the animals frontend keeps as a recorded decision rather than as code: the platform's eight architecture decisions, the live-animals set's per-page design record under its 15 headings, and the journey, feature, limit, obligation and copy-status notes beside them, with any gap between a recorded decision and the code. It claims what has already been ruled on a page, not the page's own behaviour, which that page's area claims from the code, the traces and the specs.

areas.title: The plants set journey specification and ledgers
areas.scope: What the high-risk plants set records as already settled: spec/journey-spec.json with its per-field obligations and happy-path fixture, the decisions, conflicts and backlog-extras ledgers, and the review panel dockets, rulings, reconciliation and critic entries. It claims rulings and recorded decisions, not page behaviour, which each page area claims from the plants code and specs. The set docs are plants-set-docs.

areas.title: The plants set docs
areas.scope: src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs in the high-risk plants frontend: its served-surface reference, its guides and its four recipes, read for the behaviour they state and the judgements they record. It claims what the docs say about the plants set, not page behaviour proven in code, which each page area claims from the plants code and specs.

areas.title: Journey flow, step order and what applies when
areas.scope: How the notification journey hangs together across pages: the version mount and session, the step order and next-page rules, the opening run, change and return contexts (from hub, from review, from template review), the shared journey buttons and their actions, the status strip and reference, the obligations and scope rules saying which questions apply to which consignment and what is optional versus a hard stop, the prototype route and coverage tables, and the tests repo journey scope and conditional-rule specs. Stops at any one page content and at journeys walked whole (whole-journeys). Includes the high-risk plants frontend flow, entry guard, section captions, route registration, obligation manifest and cross-page fit specs.

areas.title: Whole notification journeys walked end to end
areas.scope: The notification journey walked whole, from create to submitted, in every source: the prototype end-to-end traces (cattle, horse, poultry, pet cats, germinal products) and its journeys spec, the animals frontend repo-root fit journey driver and smoke spec, the plants fit harness and journey smoke spec, the tests repo whole-journey and reference-list content specs, and the k6 journey-page walker. It claims the run order, which pages each species, set and transport mode gets or skips, and what the review and submitted pages show when filled. Each page keeps its own content in its own area; step-order and scope rules stay with journey-flow.

areas.title: Accessibility, visual and security suites and the test suite set-up
areas.scope: The tests repo accessibility suites (animals and INS), visual-regression specs and baselines, frontend and address-book security specs and ZAP config, and the suite configuration, scripts and documentation: what is scanned and run where, at which viewports, with which rules and exclusions, and what the suite claims to prove. It stops at what a page does, which each page area claims.

areas.title: Layout, navigation, sign-in and shared page chrome
areas.scope: What every page shares: the GOV.UK header, service name, service navigation and its items, phase banner and feedback link, footer, page title pattern, section captions, back links, error summary and shared error messages, error pages, the prototype index and version cards, sign-in, organisation choice, sign-out, organisation scoping and sessions across services, and security headers. Stops at the journey step order and scope rules (journey-flow) and at the accessibility, visual and security suites (test-suites). Includes the high-risk plants frontend shared layout, kit, save actions and shared copy, and its chrome, sign-in and Welsh rulings.
